Biomimetic Dentistry

Crown-Free Restorations

Traditional crowns destroy teeth. They all leak, allowing bacteria to hide underneath where it's impossible to clean, leading to a destructive cycle of crown replacement, root canals, and eventual tooth loss.

Dr. Noot's Crown-Free Approach

Dr. Noot layers composite resins and crafts custom inlays, onlays, and veneers that create a crown-free, seamless fit. This approach preserves your natural tooth strength while eliminating the leakage problems that plague traditional crowns.

Preserves natural tooth structure — No unnecessary drilling or healthy tooth removal
Seamless integration — Restorations bond perfectly with your natural teeth
Long-lasting results — No crown replacement cycles, lifetime durability
"There is no better restorative dentist that I have trained in the last 8 years." — Dr. David S. Alleman, Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry
Advanced Technology

Microscope Precision & Gentle Care

Dr. Noot uses advanced technology for every patient and every procedure, ensuring the highest level of precision and comfort.

Microscope Precision — Used for every patient and every procedure, providing unmatched accuracy and allowing you to watch your treatment on screen
Air Abrasion — The safest way to clean teeth and prepare surfaces for bonding, eliminating the need for aggressive drilling
Diagnodent Laser — Finds hidden decay in deep grooves that traditional methods miss, catching problems before they become serious

No needles, no grinding drills — Advanced techniques eliminate discomfort while preserving maximum tooth structure.

Preventative Care

Reduce Decay by Over 90%

Prevention is the foundation of biomimetic dentistry. Dr. Noot's advanced preventative approach identifies and addresses problems before they require invasive treatment.

Comprehensive Prevention Program

Bacteria Identification

Special stains identify trouble spots and harmful bacteria before they cause damage.

Custom Oral Rinses

Balanced rinses customized for your saliva acidity help neutralize harmful conditions.

VELscope Screening

Advanced scans detect infections, inflammation, tumors, and cancer in early stages.

Advanced Sealing

New sealing materials and techniques provide superior protection against decay.

Healthy Mouth Assessment Tools

Saliva Quality Test — Assess your natural protective factors
Bacterial Cultures — Identify harmful bacteria before damage occurs
Plaque Analysis — Understand your unique oral health challenges
Diagnodent Laser Scanning — Find hidden decay traditional methods miss
Hygiene Services

The Cleanest Mouth You've Ever Had

Dr. Noot's hygiene services use the latest technology to provide superior cleaning while being gentle on your teeth and gums.

Regular Check-ups with Latest Technology — Comprehensive examinations using microscopy and advanced diagnostic tools
UltraSonic Teeth Cleaning — No more scraping! Gentle ultrasonic cleaning removes plaque and tartar without discomfort
Air Polishing — Removes plaque from hard-to-reach places using natural anti-microbial properties

Experience the difference — Patients are amazed at how clean and smooth their teeth feel after Dr. Noot's advanced hygiene treatment.
